9.label: 9(a)
9.answer: Let p be the price of a pencil and b the price of a pen. 2p + b = 1500 and p + 2b = 2000.
9.explanation: One mark for the definitions and one per correct equation.

9.label: 9(b)
9.answer: b = 1500 − 2p. Substitute to get p + 3000 − 4p = 2000, hence p = 1000/3 and b = 2500/3.
9.explanation: One mark for isolating b, one for substitution and one for each price.

9.label: 9(c)
9.answer: A pencil costs 1000/3 TZS (about 333.33 TZS). A pen costs 2500/3 TZS (about 833.33 TZS). The exact values satisfy both totals.
